description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release lets you add pi-ai provider models to DeepSeek from the settings page, updates Codex to 2.8.0 with the GPT-6.2 models and Claude Code to 0.109.0, keeps Claude Code's plan visible after a turn ends, makes OpenCode more reliable while it is starting, and further reduces memory use and background work.
New
- You can now set up pi-ai provider routes for DeepSeek on the settings page. Each provider's models show up as their own group in the model picker. (#1188, @ker2xu)
Improved
- Updated Codex (codex-acp) to 2.8.0 and Claude Code (claude-agent-acp) to 0.109.0. Codex now offers GPT-6.2 Sol (the new default) and GPT-6.2 Astra, and the model placeholder in the input box shows GPT-6.2. Switching a Codex conversation's model provider now shows a clear message instead of quietly starting a new conversation and losing its history.
- When OpenCode is still starting up, codeg now waits briefly and retries opening the conversation instead of showing a generic error. If it is still not ready, the original conversation is kept rather than replaced by an empty one. (#1190, @ker2xu)
- Less background work while the app is open: the "time ago" labels in the sidebar update without re-rendering the whole list, multiple desktop windows connected to a remote server no longer process each other's events, and connection keepalive checks no longer pile up when a reply is slow. (#1191, #1199, #1201, @kogekiplay)
Fixed
- Claude Code's plan checklist no longer disappears from Session Details after a turn ends or when you reopen a conversation. (#1203 reported by @xhaozhuo-eng)
- A Claude sub-agent still running in the background no longer gets cut off when the main agent ends its turn, so automated tasks wait for it to finish. (#1198 reported by @ttxhxz)
- Reduced memory retained when you scroll long conversations, close terminals, browse the pet marketplace or change custom agent icons, and after replies with large tool outputs. (#1189, #1192, #1193, #1195, #1197, #1205, @kogekiplay)
Thanks to @kogekiplay and @ker2xu for contributing to this release, and to @ttxhxz and @xhaozhuo-eng for the reports.
